body: 现代竖版中文健身训练示意信息图，3:4，标题“全身基础训练”。目标框“目标｜基础力量”；时间框“时长｜45分钟”；对象“初级”。热身框“热身5分钟”。四个动作卡配人体姿势示意和名称：“深蹲”“墙壁俯卧撑”“臀桥”“鸟狗式”。底部三个短框：“进阶｜逐渐加次数”“替代｜减小幅度”“恢复｜轻柔拉伸”。提醒“动作无痛，量力而行”。浅灰背景，蓝绿点缀，中文清晰；这是布局示意，不呈现治疗建议，不添加负重数据。

en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.

## Observed result

Four named movement panels and the warm-up, progression, alternative and recovery modules are readable. The model added explanations; the image is a layout concept, not validated exercise instruction.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 40. [Source](https://github.com/ZeroLu/awesome-gpt-image/blob/main/README.md#fitness-training-infographic). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
